name: nus-promo
description: nus promo film. 30 s at 152 bpm, scored on Ableton's Perc Kitchen Kit.

scripts.render: npm run footage && npm run score && remotion render Object out/picture.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 14 && npm run mux
scripts.render:prores: npm run score && remotion render Object out/nus-promo.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444
scripts.cut: remotion render Cut out/rough/cut-picture.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/rough/cut-picture.mp4 -i ableton/bounce.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=-1.5dB,apad[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 30.0 out/rough/nus-cut.mp4
